findings.proposed: UN R118 (burning behaviour of interior materials)
findings.evidence: UN R21 covers interior fittings (head-impact/energy absorption), not flammability; the FMVSS 302 counterpart is UN R118 (also ISO 3795). Body: 'requires that these materials not burn or transmit a flame front ... exceeding 102 mm per minute'. Based on standard knowledge of UN R21/R118 scopes; no web check.

UN R95 is lateral collision protection; FMVSS 226 is ejection mitigation (side-window ejection impactor test/rollover). Body S2: applies to vehicles '4,536 kg or less' ... ejection of occupants through side windows. Not a counterpart.

findings.proposed: UN R110 (CNG/LNG specific components; container requirements)
findings.evidence: UN R34 covers fire-risk prevention (liquid fuel tanks); CNG containers are covered by UN R110. Body S3: 'each container designed to store CNG as motor fuel on-board any motor vehicle'.
UN R34 is fire-risk prevention for liquid-fuel vehicles; CNG vehicle fuel system is UN R110. Body S3: 'use CNG as a motor fuel'.

findings.proposed: UN R134 (hydrogen vehicle safety); related UN GTR 13
findings.evidence: R34 does not cover hydrogen systems; UN R134 is the hydrogen/fuel-cell vehicle regulation. Body S3: 'uses compressed hydrogen gas as a fuel source'.

findings.proposed: UN R134 / UN GTR 13 (hydrogen storage system) as AI-suggested
findings.evidence: Hydrogen CHSS integrity has well-known UN counterparts (R134, GTR 13) but none is tagged. Based on standard knowledge, not web-checked.

Body S1/S2 and summary say 4,536 kg but S3 reads 'trailers and semitrailers with a GVWR of 4,356 kg or more' (digit transposition; eCFR source believed to read 4,536 - unverified here since gov sites blocked).

findings.proposed: UN R80 (strength of seats and anchorages, large passenger vehicles); R14/R16 only loosely related
findings.evidence: FMVSS 222 covers school-bus seat padding/compartmentalization and wheelchair anchorage; R16 (belts) and R17 (seat strength, M1/N) are not counterparts for buses. Body S3: 'applies to school buses'.

findings.evidence: Bus rollover structural integrity has the well-known counterpart UN R66; not mapped. Standard knowledge, not web-checked.
Rear impact guards have counterpart UN R58 (RUPD); not mapped (same for us-fmvss-224). Standard knowledge, not web-checked.
